market.question: Will the highest temperature in Taipei be 31°C on May 2?

assessment.reasoning: Taipei early May average high is ~25-26°C and May 2 falls at the start of the plum rain season with rain/clouds depressing temps. Question requires highest temp at Songshan station to be in the 31°C bracket - well above typical early-May highs. Unlikely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Anomalous warm dry day before plum rains arrive could push high temporarily.
